name: refresh-google-only
description: The ordinary refresh hosts (the R2 bucket, GitHub Pages, the pack URL) and script.google.com are reset by SNI; www.google.com is open. Nothing a direct family uses is touched. Op google-refresh: a phone connected when its relay's address is null-routed and the relay has moved finds the new address through the Google front (SNI www.google.com, authority script.google.com, one redirect) and reconnects with no new file.
analogue: Plan §3.1: the Google channel carries the fix when the usual refresh addresses are blocked or SNI-filtered, because Google is the name most often left open; MasterHttpRelayVPN-RUST #313 (April 2026: script.google.com blocked, the front partly open). Model: exact names, reassembling, RST both ways. Not modelled: Google's front breaking (refresh-google-rst), the HTTP/2 fingerprint of the fetch, Apps Script quotas.
